+def resolve(data):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages)
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    roots = data.get("roots", {})

+    def visit(assign, limits, graph):
+        nonlocal best
+        # Validate all constraints accumulated so far.
+        for name, (lo, hi) in limits.items():
+            if name in assign and not lo <= assign[name] <= hi:
+                return
+        pending = [n for n in limits if n not in assign]
+        if not pending:
+            # Reject directed cycles in the selected dependency graph.
+            active, done = set(), set()
+            def acyclic(node):
+                if node in active:
+                    return False
+                if node in done:
+                    return True
+                active.add(node)
+                if any(not acyclic(child) for child in graph.get(node, ())):
+                    return False
+                active.remove(node)
+                done.add(node)
+                return True
+            if not all(acyclic(n) for n in assign):
+                return
+            vector = tuple(assign.get(n, -1) for n in names)
+            if best is None or vector < best[0]:
+                best = (vector, dict(assign))
+            return
+
+        name = min(pending)
+        lo, hi = limits[name]
+        versions = sorted(row["version"] for row in packages[name]
+                          if lo <= row["version"] <= hi
+                          and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                          and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name]))
+        for version in versions:
+            row = next(r for r in packages[name] if r["version"] == version)
+            new_assign = dict(assign)
+            new_assign[name] = version
+            new_limits = dict(limits)
+            new_graph = {k: list(v) for k, v in graph.items()}
+            deps = [d for d in row.get("deps", [])
+                    if not d.get("feature") or d["feature"] in features]
+            new_graph[name] = [d["name"] for d in deps]
+            valid = True

+                child = dep["name"]

+                if child in new_limits:

+                    low, high = max(low, old_low), min(high, old_high)
